about: Which YARA Forge rule sources TacoGuard may use. A source is kept only when its license text matches an 'allow' entry and no 'deny' entry. Sources without a license file are left out. Single rules are also left out when their own license meta or source URL matches a 'deny' entry. Checked in order; the first allow match names the license.

allow.pattern: Redistribution and use in source and binary forms
